task.note: Long-video sharded random walk, on the profile the Tokyo coverage episode was recorded and accepted with: the road network is whatever region has the longest centreline, NOT the built-up core. Core confinement was tried and abandoned - on four maps measured end to end it needed a 60 cm body clearance, a 120 cm corridor and a reroute loop to pass its gates, and delivered a fraction of the footage. This profile is the one with a passing episode behind it.
task.family_note: coverage_walk IS the random walk. coverage.py:coverage_walk takes a random unwalked road at each junction rather than solving route inspection, and prepare_walks chains one pass into the next from where the last ended. A separate random_walk family would have been a second copy of the same traversal.
task.action_mix_note: coverage_tokyo_stroll's bands verbatim. Achieved there: forward 31.9%, backward 16.5%, turn 14.4/13.6%, look 8.6/9.4%, hold 5.6%, in band. The floors sum to 0.67, so the bands are jointly satisfiable.
task.camera_note: pitch_limit_up_deg caps looking UP at 15 deg while looking down keeps 30. Not taste: ASimWorldCaptureActor refuses to write a frame whose depth channel is entirely invalid and calls Finish, and pitching up on a street empties it - measured 35.5% of the frame valid at pitch 0, 3.6% at 20 deg, zero at 27.5, which ended a capture 97519 frames in. A single 20 h episode has no checkpoint, so this cap matters more here than it did there.
task.body_note: Tokyo's own values. 6 cm is a step offset - a capsule resting exactly on the floor reports a hit at distance 0 - and 90 cm is the corridor clearance that produced Tokyo's 1065 m network, 0 collisions and a depth probe whose nearest reading was 85.2 cm. On rolling terrain inside a CORE these are not enough (WinterTown: 989 collisions, 20% of the network kept), which is documented in FINDINGS.md - but this profile does not walk cores.
task.reroute_note: MAX_REROUTE_ATTEMPTS defaults to 4 and is left on: it costs nothing when a route is already clean, and it is what turns a blocked place into a different road rather than a refused map.

head_clearance_pruning.method: capsule r=40 half-h=88 cm, centred 6 cm above the walkable surface, swept along each road at 40 cm steps. A road is dropped if any sweep along it is blocked; sweeps straddling two roads are discarded by index.
head_clearance_pruning.why: a navmesh is built for the navmesh agent's radius and height, so walkable surface can run under pipes, awnings and gantries that this camera does not clear

reroutes.note: places a previous attempt's body capsule hit, near plane entered, or depth probe found geometry inside; cut out of the corridor so the walk turns and takes another road. Counted, not hidden - the coverage fraction is still measured from the poses.

collision_surface.method: downward trace from each point's navmesh height + 60 cm, batched in 150 cm z bands, cached on a 50 cm grid
collision_surface.why: the navmesh is not the collision surface; a capsule placed on the navmesh can start inside the terrain, and the camera inherits the same offset

coverage.method: every point of a road within 160 cm of some frame's camera position, sampled every 40 cm; measured from the delivered poses, not from the plan

length.tuned_on_note: the action mix was tuned on a one-pass proxy and the reported mix was measured on the full-length episode

ensure.provenance: synthesised by this call and NOT saved into the map; walkable surface outside the region exists in the level but was not generated here
ensure.note: build dispatched; the navigation system already reports idle, which on entry can also mean it has not started yet - poll nav_build_status rather than trusting it

collision.clearance_note: 104135 of 358560 frames had an obstacle within 1500 cm
collision.method: capsule r=40 half-h=88 cm swept between consecutive frames, centred 6 cm above the surface; near plane traced at its four corners

depth_probe.all_sky_note: an all-sky probe is a VETO: the capture actor refuses to write a depth channel containing no depth and ends the run. `thin` frames are the same failure approaching - under 1% of the probe had valid depth.
depth_probe.method: scene depth rendered at every 1434th frame's exact pose, 320x180, max range 200 m; this is the only check that sees geometry whose collision is disabled

reachability.method: not run for this family: the in-engine capture places the scene-capture components on the frozen pose and spawns no pawn, and the route is already navmesh-planned, corridor-swept per frame and depth-probed

known_gaps: instance/ and semantic/ masks are not captured by this build
section 12 depth_visible_overlap and fully_occluded_interval are not computed; this family has no revisit events, so those gates do not apply to it either way
